content: ASP.NET Core 10: builder.Services.AddValidation() source-generated DataAnnotations/IValidatableObject validation for Minimal APIs, DisableValidation per endpoint; multi-assembly requires AddValidation per assembly. OpenAPI 3.1 default, Microsoft.OpenApi 2.0. Cookie auth returns 401/403 for API endpoints (IApiEndpointMetadata). Identity metrics, passkeys. Exception handler no longer logs handled exceptions. Source learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/release-notes/aspnetcore-10.0.
